whyCommon: Cross-border call centers plus AI voices dial 24/7 at scale.

howSpot: Question phrases like “state-backed” or “media partnership” you can't verify.
Treat any request to transfer into personal accounts as a red flag.
Watch for uncanny lip-sync or blinking artifacts in AI-generated media.
whatNow: Flag suspicious numbers in the National Anti-Fraud app.
Freeze bank/payment accounts and ask banks to halt transfers.
Archive chats and receipts, then report to the police.
